title: Bind full verification callers and retention to genuine source owners
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies the complete source argument connecting genuine cache/full-caller context and automatic retention to their actual consumers at [PR #6867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6867). The proof traces real private modules, cold authority, epoch/caller objects, full CLI and retirement, then actual registry seal, issuer, fork borrower and independent parent full readback before successful release.

This source theorem retains the original genuine-entry premise. It does not supply the missing external native-G entry owner, a live runtime instance, complete controls, original-primary comparison or successful CLOSE. Complete installation still needs the authenticated late-pin transport and its actual caller, preserving original financial/command semantics.

This is an inert source-audit archive, complete within the scope stated here and prepared Ready for review. Independent AI source analysis and a contribution-author source/criterion audit do not constitute human review, proof-kernel acceptance, runtime admission or a speedup claim. The original predicates, independent oracles, modes, reservations and error/cleanup semantics remain unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Explicit follow-up to [the original investigation and maintained specification/PR map](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045). Scope is unchanged. Extends [#6869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6869) with constructor-to-consumer and lifecycle proofs. The apparent retention-cache loader concern is resolved by reached-call analysis, not by permitting arbitrary module mutation. Pending child success cannot supply the parent acceptance gate. Earlier accepted scientific internals are reused within their original source contracts; omitted bodies are not described as newly reread.

Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; owning implementation head `319ea1c5f4097ef87cc0b037327f26374e93e54d`; exact internal reconciliation head `1144f0a715e84b3f08ebe7d0e8ed8a06543f2fad`. The source decision, certificate and scope records retain exact predecessor pins and credit, including #6715/#6736/#6752/#6756, #6830 and #6863/#6864/#6866/#6867. External immutable source dependencies are explicit; they are not assumed to be ancestors of this audit commit.

## Validation

- Completed independent Pro source argument and challenging review, followed by the contribution-author assessment against the unchanged original criterion.
- All 6 committed UTF-8 file bodies were fetched independently and matched their exact Git blob identities. Every non-self entry in `INTEGRITY.json` matched its declared byte count and SHA256.
- JSON certificates and scope records parse successfully. Existing complete 66-leaf source subject and accepted scientific 52-helper/65-context selection are retained at the unchanged implementation head.
- No selected implementation changed. No target import, archive decompression, native/compiler/scientific work, unchanged control rerun, new financial/runtime operation or guarded policy debit. Physical preparation/review/publication and historical gaps remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

There is no registered replay hook for this inert source archive. The README and certificate give immutable source acquisition, byte identity and review boundaries. Hosted planning/onboarding and skipped replay are separate from scientific qualification; exact-head results will be recorded after submission. Actual runtime/currentness/native/resource qualification, full control union, original-primary comparison and successful CLOSE remain separate obligations.

## Credit

Preserves the original Clear1nsight investigation and linked predecessor source/proof contributions and notices. Prepared with substantial ChatGPT Pro and OpenAI Codex assistance. New material is Apache-2.0. AI review supplies no maintainer endorsement.
